inicial.meta_descricao: Carbono Consciente: uburezi ku bidukikije ku byerekeye ibyuka bihumanya ikirere, ikigero cya karubone, inama z'iterambere rirambye, ibintu bitangaje, n'amakuru y'ibidukikije.

hero.titulo: Buri myitwarire ntoya igabanya uburemere ku isi
hero.texto: CARBONO CONSCIENTE SI IKIMENYETSO CY'ICATSI CYANGWA INTEGO Y'INTARA — NI UMUBARE W'IBYEMEZO BISANZWE, BISUBIRAMO BURI MUNSI: IBYO UTERA, UKO WIMUKA, IGIHE UZIMYA UMUCYO, AHO UJUGUNYA IMYANDA.

acordeao.emissao_corpo: Ibyuka bya karubone ni ugusohora imyuka nka CO₂ mu kirere, cyane cyane biturutse mu gutwika lavuta y'ibinyabutabire by'imyaka myinshi, gutema amashyamba, inganda, no mu gutwara abantu busanzwe.
acordeao.clima_corpo: Ibyuka bihumanya ikirere bigira urwego rufata ubushyuhe mu kirere. Uko ibyuka byiyongera, ni ko ingaruka ziba nini — kandi ni byo bitera ubushyuhe bw'isi n'imihindagurikire y'ikirere.
acordeao.pegada_corpo: Ni umubare wose w'ibyuka bihumanya ikirere, bitewe ku buryo butaziguye cyangwa buziguye, n'ibikorwa by'umuntu, isosiyete cyangwa igicuruzwa mu buzima bwa buri munsi.
acordeao.neutro_corpo: Karubone isanzwe (neutre) igerageza guhuza cyangwa guhemba ibyuka byasohowe. Carbono consciente ishyira imbere ibyemezo bigabanya ingaruka ku bidukikije mbere n'uko hatekerezwa ku guhemba.

curiosidades.erro_carregar: Ntibyashobotse gutangiza ibintu bitangaje muri iki gihe.

fatos.fato1: Igiti kigeze mu bukure gifata impuzandengo ya kg 22 za CO₂ ku mwaka — ni yo mpamvu gutera ibiti bushya ari kimwe mu buryo bworoshye cyane bwo kuringaniza ibyuka bihumanya ikirere bisohoka.
fatos.fato2: Inyanja zifata impuzandengo ya kimwe cya kane cy'ibyuka bya CO₂ byose abantu basohora ku mwaka, zikaba nk'igikoresho kinini kigenzura ikirere ku isi.
fatos.fato3: Gusubiramo gukoresha toni imwe y'impapuro bizigama ibiti nka 17 n'amazi n'ingufu nyinshi ugereranyije no gukora impapuro nshya.
fatos.fato4: Ubwikorezi bufata impuzandengo ya kimwe cya kane cy'ibyuka bya CO₂ byose biva ku ngufu ku isi — guhindura imodoka ukoresha igare cyangwa ubwikorezi rusange mu ngendo ngufi bigira ingaruka nziza nyazo.
fatos.fato5: Ishyamba rya Amazone ni ho hava hafi 10% by'ibinyabuzima byose bizwi ku isi, kandi ribika amamiliyari y'amatoni ya karubone mu bimera byaryo.
fatos.fato6: Utubaho tw'izuba two ku mazu dushobora kugabanya ingaruka za karubone z'inzu ku toni za CO₂ ku mwaka, bitewe n'uburyo ingufu zikoreshwa aho uba.
fatos.fato7: Kurya inyama nke z'umutuku birashobora kugabanya cyane ingaruka za karubone z'umuntu, kubera ko korora inka ari kimwe mu bikorwa by'ubuhinzi bisohora ibyuka byinshi byangiza ikirere.
fatos.fato8: Gushonga kw'urubura rw'inyanja ya Arctique bigabanya ubushobozi bw'isi bwo kugaruza urumuri rw'izuba mu kirere, bikongera ubushyuhe — ikintu kizwi nka 'albedo feedback' (ingaruka zisubiramo z'urumuri).
fatos.fato9: Amatara ya LED akoresha ingufu nke ku kigero kigera kuri 80% ugereranyije n'amatara asanzwe, kandi amara igihe kirekire, bigatuma hagabanuka ibyuka n'imyanda.
fatos.fato10: Amasezerano ya Paris, yashyizweho umukono n'ibihugu bigera kuri 200, agamije kugabanya iyongezwa ry'ubushyuhe bw'isi munsi cyane ya 2°C hejuru y'urugero rwabayeho mbere y'inganda.
fatos.fato11: Hafi kimwe cya gatatu cy'ibiribwa byose bikorerwa ku isi birajugunywa — kandi ubwo buhunzi bwonyine bisohora igice kinini cy'ibyuka byangiza ikirere ku isi.
fatos.fato12: Imashini z'umuyaga zigezweho zishobora gukora ingufu zihagije zo gutanga amashanyarazi mu mazu agera ku bihumbi, bitarangiza CO₂ mu gihe zikora.
fatos.fato13: Ubutaka buzima bubika karubone nyinshi kurusha ibimera byose n'ikirere byose hamwe — uburyo bw'ubuhinzi busubiza ubutaka ubuzima butuma iyo karubone igumira mu butaka.
fatos.fato14: Amahurizo ya korali, nubwo atwikira munsi ya 1% cy'ikibaya cy'inyanja, afasha hafi 25% by'ibinyabuzima byose bizwi by'inyanja — kandi arumva cyane iyo amazi ashyushye.
fatos.fato15: Kugabanya gutakaza amazi ashyushye mu rugo (urugero, koga mu gihe gito) nabyo bigabanya ibyuka, kubera ko gushyusha amazi gukoresha ingufu.
fatos.fato16: Imodoka z'amashanyarazi, nubwo twitwaje uko bateri zikorwa, akenshi zisohora CO₂ nke mu gihe cyose zizamara ugereranyije n'imodoka zikoresha lisansi, cyane cyane aho amashanyarazi aturuka ku ngufu zitanduye.
fatos.fato17: Guhindura imyanda y'ibinyabuzima mu rugo kugira ngo ibe ifumbire kurinda ko isohora gaze metani mu hantu h'imyanda — gaze yangiza ikirere kurusha CO₂ mu gihe gito.
fatos.fato18: Urubura rw'i Groenlande no muri Antarctique hamwe burahunga mu myaka iheze amamiliyari magana y'amatoni ku mwaka, bikagira uruhara runini mu kuzamura urwego rw'amazi y'inyanja.

globo.sem_dados_territorio: Nta makuru ku byuka bya CO₂ kuri buri muntu abonetse kuri iyi ntara.
globo.fonte_estimativa: Igitekerezo ku byuka bya CO₂ biturutse mu bikomoka ku binyabutabire by'imyaka myinshi kuri buri muntu (Global Carbon Budget / Our World in Data, umwaka ngenderwaho 2024).
globo.aria_interativo: Isi y'ikoranabuhanga ishoboka gukoreshwaho ku byerekeye ibyuka bya karubone. Kurura kugira izenguruke, zenguruka kugira wegereze, kanda ku gihugu kugira urebe amakuru, hanyuma ukande kabiri kugira wereke iyo isi.
globo.aria_decorativo: Isi y'ikinyoreza izenguruka, yerekana uko umushinga Carbono Consciente ugera ku isi yose.
